== [[Seed 2009/Invitation|Invitation]] ==
You are receiving this invitation because someone wants to see you at Seed 2009.  Seed 2009 is an un-conference for the folks who will build a community that "Brings Life" to each of us, to our communities, and to the entire galaxy.

To learn more, visit [[Seed 2009]] and add yourself to  [[Seed_2009/Participants|the participants list]] if you're planning to attend.
